test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

Astronomers consider the year 2020 to be eventful in the celestial world __until__ the four eclipses.
solution:
The correct answer is 'because of.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment, the use of the preposition 'until' is incorrect.
 
• The preposition 'until' means **up to the time or the event mentioned**.
 
• The given sentence is telling **why the Astronomers consider the year 2020 to be eventful**.
 
• Therefore, the **preposition ''because of''** should be used **in place of** the **preposition 'until'**.
 
• The preposition ''because of'' means **as a result of; on account of**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct Sentence: *Astronomers consider the year 2020 to be eventful in the celestial world **because of **the four eclipses*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The **phrase** ''**even though**'' means **despite the fact that**. (यद्यपि, हालाँकि)
 
• The preposition '**notwithstanding**' means **in spite of something**. (के बावजूद भी)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• रेखांकित खण्ड में preposition 'until' का प्रयोग गलत है।
 
• Preposition 'until' का अर्थ है **निर्दिष्ट समय या घटना के होने तक**।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य बता रहा है कि **खगोल-विज्ञानी वर्ष 2020 को घटनापूर्ण क्यों मानते हैं**।
 
• इसलिए preposition ''because of'' का प्रयोग preposition 'until' के स्थान पर किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• Preposition ''because of'' का अर्थ है **के कारण, की वजह से, के परिणामस्‍वरूप; फलस्‍वरूप**।

 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

सही वाक्य: *Astronomers consider the year 2020 to be eventful in the celestial world because of the four eclipses*.
